text:

Jackson was then convicted in March 2024 to serve in prison and house arrest for 52 consecutive weeks and served that punishment when Trump enlarged grace last month.
But now, Jackson told Newsweek, His company, Patriot Service Electric, is flooded with negative assessments and e -mails – many of which come from outside his community, including from Washington DC and Maryland.

But he said he also received death threats and was concerned about the safety of his family.

He noticed that the negative reviews started for the first time after he was arrested by the FBI, but said they have only gotten worse since he was grace.
Yet Jackson said that he did not tell the police about the threats because “I am not afraid of cowards.”
And, he said, the negative reviews seemed to be counterproductive – as more members of the community have appeared to support his company.

“Although it can be exhaustive to deal with the attacks, it offers us more support.”
“We run an honest company and offer quality service to our community,” he added.
